verses.text: Here are the nations Yahweh left behind to test Israel—the people who hadn’t lived through all the wars in Canaan yet. ⚔️
He left them so the next generations of Israelites could learn how to fight, especially the ones who hadn’t been through a war before. 🛡️
They included the five Philistine rulers, all the Canaanites and Sidonians, and the Hivites living on Mount Lebanon from Baal-hermon to the entrance of Hamath. 🗺️
These nations stayed to test Israel and find out whether they’d listen to Yahweh’s commands, the ones he gave their ancestors through Moses. 📜
Israel lived among the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites. 🏘️
They married their daughters, gave their own daughters to their sons, and served their gods. ⚠️
Israel did evil in Yahweh’s sight. They forgot Yahweh their God and served the Baals and Asheroth. ⚠️
So Yahweh’s anger burned against Israel. He handed them over to Cushan-rishathaim, king of Mesopotamia. Israel served him for eight years. ⚖️
Then Israel cried out to Yahweh, and Yahweh raised up a rescuer for them: Othniel son of Kenaz, Caleb’s younger brother. 🛡️
Yahweh’s Spirit came on Othniel. He led Israel and went out to war, and Yahweh handed Cushan-rishathaim, king of Mesopotamia, over to him. Othniel overpowered him. ⚔️
The land had peace for forty years. Then Othniel son of Kenaz died. 🕊️
Israel’s people went back to doing evil in Yahweh’s sight. So Yahweh strengthened Eglon, king of Moab, against Israel because of their evil. ⚠️
Eglon gathered the Ammonites and Amalekites around him, attacked Israel, and took the City of Palms. ⚔️
Israel served Eglon, king of Moab, for eighteen years. 🕰️
Then Israel cried out to Yahweh, and Yahweh raised up a rescuer for them: Ehud son of Gera, a left-handed Benjaminite. Israel sent him to deliver tribute to Eglon, king of Moab. 🛡️
Ehud made himself a double-edged sword about a cubit long and strapped it under his clothes on his right thigh. 🗡️
He brought the tribute to Eglon, king of Moab. Eglon was an extremely heavy man. 👑
After Ehud finished presenting the tribute, he sent the people who carried it away. 🎁
But Ehud himself turned back near the stone idols by Gilgal. He said, ‘King, I have a secret message for you.’ Eglon said, ‘Quiet!’ and everyone standing around him left. 🤫
Ehud came in while Eglon was sitting alone in the cool upper room. Ehud said, ‘I have a message from God for you.’ Eglon got up from his seat. 🗣️
Then Ehud reached with his left hand, pulled the sword from his right thigh, and drove it into Eglon’s body. ⚔️
The handle went in after the blade, and the fat closed over it. Ehud didn’t pull the sword back out; it came out behind him. ⚔️
Ehud went out onto the porch, shut the upper-room doors behind him, and locked them. 🚪
After he left, Eglon’s servants came and saw the upper-room doors were locked. They thought, ‘He must be taking care of business in the cool room.’ 🤔
They waited until it got awkward, but he still didn’t open the doors. So they got the key, unlocked them, and found their king lying dead on the floor. 🔑
While they waited, Ehud got away. He passed the stone idols and escaped to Seirah. 🏃
When he arrived, he blew a trumpet in Ephraim’s hill country. Israel’s people came down from the hills with him, and he led them. 📯
He told them, ‘Follow me! Yahweh has handed your enemies, the Moabites, over to you.’ They followed him, took the Jordan crossings facing Moab, and didn’t let anyone cross. 🌊
They struck down about 10,000 Moabite men that day—all strong, capable fighters. Not one escaped. ⚔️
That day Moab was brought under Israel’s control. Then the land had peace for eighty years. 🕊️
After Ehud came Shamgar son of Anath. He struck down six hundred Philistines with an ox goad, and he too rescued Israel. 🐂
